sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Fire Release, Lightning Release, Fuinjutsu

system.description:
You transform your entire body into plasma. Your movement speed is increased by +30 and ranged attacks that target you, have disadvantage on their attacks.

If you are standing in an area illuminated by one of your Starlight’s, you can spend your Action to target one hostile creature within 60 feet of you, forcing them to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they are struck by a bolt of light, that seals their eyes, making it all but impossible to target creatures further than 30 feet from them. Creatures further than 30 feet from the affected creature is treated as Invisible to the affected creature. An affected creature remakes their saving throw at the end of each of their turns.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost by 3. If this jutsu is cast to A-Rank or higher, using the special reaction granted by this jutsu no longer automatically ends it the first time you use this reaction per casting. If this jutsu is cast to S-Rank, your movement speed is instead tripled.
